ag.stopMsg: Your agents are paused, their waiting requests denied and anything running is stopped. Resume each one when you’re ready.
ag.stopMsgAdmin: Every agent on this server is paused, waiting requests are denied, anything running is stopped and NoCap MCP is switched off.
ag.stopped: Stopped: {paused} paused, {denied} requests denied, {stopped} runs ended
ag.revokeMsg: Its token stops working right away. You can add it again any time.
ag.heroTitle: Let your AI agents use this server
ag.heroHint: Agents that speak MCP get NoCapOS’s tools, limited to what you allow each one. Looking around is instant;
ag.accessAdminOnly: Only an administrator can change these.
ag.letInOn: On: agents with a token can connect.
ag.letInOff: Off: every agent token is ignored.
ag.loopbackOn: Agents on other devices can’t connect, even with a token.
ag.loopbackOff: Agents added as “other devices” can connect over the network. Keep tokens secret.
ag.assistantHint: What the built-in AI Assistant may do for you. Everything is off until you turn it on.
ag.yoursHint: Each agent has its own profile: what it can touch, where it connects from, until when.
ag.none: No agents yet. Choose Add an agent to make one.
ag.kindLocalHint: Runs on this server (agents started here). It can’t connect from anywhere else.
ag.kindRemoteHint: Runs on another computer on your network. Limit it to its address below.
ag.kindRemoteBlocked: Runs on another computer. It can’t connect until an administrator turns off “Only agents on this machine”.
ag.rotateMsg: Its current token stops working right away.
ag.pauseHint: Turn on to block it for now without losing its setup.
ag.pausedHint: Paused: every request is turned away.
ag.name: Name
ag.ipAllowHint: IP addresses or ranges, separated by commas. Leave empty to allow any address.
ag.noTools: Its access doesn’t allow any tools.
ag.askAgain: Ask me again for this one
ag.preset.read_only.hint: Looks at files, photos, logs, system, apps and containers. Changes nothing.
ag.preset.monitoring.hint: Logs, system, network and containers, read-only.
ag.preset.files_photos.hint: Reads and changes files and photos, asking first.
ag.preset.admin.hint: Almost everything, and every change asks first. Code runs in the sandbox only.
ag.preset.full.hint: Everything, most of it without asking. Only for agents you fully trust.
ag.cap.files.hint: Your files, within the folders below.
ag.cap.photos.hint: The Photos library: list, favorite, delete.
ag.cap.system.hint: System info and storage; change renames the server.
ag.cap.network.hint: Adapters and Wi-Fi; change joins or leaves networks.
ag.cap.users.hint: Who can sign in; manage disables and enables people.
ag.cap.screen.hint: Screenshots of NoCap Desktop; control types, clicks and opens pages.
ag.cap.apps.hint: App Store apps; manage installs, starts and stops them.
ag.cap.terminal.hint: Runs shell commands as your own Linux account (never root).
ag.cap.code.hint: Python, Node or shell snippets: in a sealed sandbox, or on this server as you.
ag.cap.power.hint: Restarts or shuts down the server. Always asks first.
ag.foldersAll: Every location you can open. Add folders to limit file and photo tools to them.
ag.foldersHint: File and photo tools only work inside these.
ag.folderBad: Write a folder as location:/path, like data:/Documents
ag.activityHint: Everything your agents asked for, newest first.
ag.setupHint: Paste one of these into your agent’s MCP settings, with your token in place of the placeholder.
ag.snipCommandHint: For agents on this machine: they start cap mcp, which talks to NoCapOS locally.
ag.snipHttpHint: Streamable HTTP at {url} with your token as a bearer header (older apps: {sse}).
ag.usePairing: Pair with a one-time code instead of copying a token
ag.codeIntro: Use it on the agent’s computer within 10 minutes. It works once and becomes the agent’s token.
ag.tokenIntro: Copy it now: it’s shown only this once and NoCapOS keeps only a scrambled copy.
ag.pairCmdHint: Run this on the agent’s computer, then use cap mcp as its MCP command. Other apps can POST the code to {url}.
ag.snipYamlHint: For agents configured with YAML: add this to their MCP servers, then restart the agent.
